name: Provo (United States, 1989–2015)
description: A white field with the word 'Provo' in black italic lettering with a grey drop shadow, set over a diagonal bar shading through the colours of the spectrum from purple at the lower hoist to red at the fly.
history: Adopted 25 April 1989 to a design by Steven Hales, the rainbow bar standing for what the city called its eclectic and diverse nature. It scored 2.14 out of 10 and placed 143rd of 150 in the North American Vexillological Association's 2004 survey of American city flags — reviewers likened it to a vitamin-bottle label — and the criticism led directly to the redesign adopted in 2015.

features.role: rainbow bar rising from the lower hoist towards the fly
features.symbolism: the eclectic and diverse nature of Provo
